punchline: SEAL training produces super teams, not super soldiers.
thirty_sec: As McChrystal describes BUD/S, candidates are split into boat teams of five to eight on day one, nobody goes anywhere alone, and the officer in charge of the first phase says his job is to take individual performance out of the vocabulary.
question: What are you rewarding on your team this month: one person's result, or two people leaning on each other?
key_contrast: Super teams instead of super soldiers.
